problem: Broad low-opacity pale painted haze surrounding flower heads in final export. This differs from harmless zero-alpha RGB on pine and rock sources.
fix: Alpha remap round(clip((alpha-48)*255/207,0,255)); pixels with result alpha <=2 cleared to RGBA zero. RGB of all retained pixels unchanged.
review: Threshold comparison visually inspected on dark backdrop. Threshold 48 removes broad haze while retaining stems and petals; thresholds 80+ visibly damage fine stems and are rejected.
